user_query: trass stories from the last 3 mondays

intent.goal: find Trass stories from the last 3 Mondays

generated_sql:
SELECT DISTINCT
  u.page_id,
  u.title,
  u.created_time,
  u.database_name
FROM unified_content u
WHERE u.database_name IN ('trass.stories', 'stories')
  AND date(u.created_time) IN (
    date('now', '-14 days'),
    date('now', '-7 days'),
    date('now', 'weekday 1')
  )
ORDER BY u.created_time DESC
LIMIT 1000
